summary: Per-FBS verifier scope: rcf verify run --fbs <id> (repeatable) narrows the acceptance contract to the criteria bound to the named FBS items and records run.scope and run.scopeAcCount; rcf build finalise <fbs-id> passes its FBS as the filter by default, --all restores whole-chain verification, an FBS with zero bound criteria is refused before launch; the verified invariant is evaluated over the scoped set (ADR-4147).
notes: Behavioural change on the finalise default only; rcf verify run without --fbs is unchanged.
title: FBS-216 finalise per-FBS verify scope: --fbs filter, --all escape, scoped verified invariant
